_comment: Disease -> up/down gene signature mapping for the DLEPS (ONNX) build.
The signature files live in data/ and hold one ENTREZGENE_ACC per line,
no header. A disease is servable as soon as its files exist; entries
whose files are missing are listed but rejected with an actionable error.
Adding a disease is a matter of dropping the files into data/ and
adding an entry here -- no code change.
'reverse' selects the direction of the score and follows the original
DLEPS run_script (code/DLEPS/run_script in the upstream repository):
reverse = true  -- the signature states a DISEASE state (genes up and
down in that state). The score is positive when the
compound REVERSES the state, i.e. pushes the 'up'
genes down and the 'down' genes up.
reverse = false -- the signature states a THERAPEUTIC PHENOTYPE (genes
up and down when that phenotype is induced). The
score is positive when the compound MIMICS it, i.e.
pushes the 'up' genes up and the 'down' genes down.
Browning (BROWNING_up/BROWNING_down, Browning_Expert_UP) is the latter:
the upstream run_script runs it with --reverse=False, because inducing
browning is the intervention, not the disease.
'down' may be null: the score is then the enrichment of the 'up' set
alone. That is what the upstream run_script does for the expert browning
screen (--upset=Browning_Expert_UP with no --downset).

Aging.label: 衰老 / 棕色脂肪（browning）
Aging.note: 诱导棕色脂肪 = 抗衰。正分 = 化合物 mimics browning（上游 run_script 用 --reverse=False）。

Aging (top 100 genes).label: 衰老 · 上/下调各取前 100 个基因（MKB 集合）
Aging (top 100 genes).note: 签名描述衰老本身（上调/下调），故取 reversal 方向：正分 = 逆转衰老特征。

Aging (expert screen).label: 衰老 · 专家筛选的精简签名
Aging (expert screen).note: 上游 run_script 只传 --upset=Browning_Expert_UP（不给 downset），故此处 down=null，只用上调集打分。

Gout.label: 痛风 / 高尿酸血症
Gout.note: 签名描述高尿酸状态本身，故取 reversal 方向。

Pulmonary fibrosis.label: 肺纤维化
Pulmonary fibrosis.note: 签名描述纤维化状态本身，故取 reversal 方向。

Non-alcoholic fatty liver disease.label: 非酒精性脂肪性肝病（NASH III 期）
Non-alcoholic fatty liver disease.note: 签名描述 NASH III 状态本身，故取 reversal 方向。

Non-alcoholic fatty liver disease (stage.label: 非酒精性脂肪性肝病（NASH IV 期）
Non-alcoholic fatty liver disease (stage.note: 签名描述 NASH IV 状态本身，故取 reversal 方向。

Obesity.label: 肥胖 / 减肥（棕色脂肪）
Obesity.note: 用 Browning_UP / Browning_Down（与 BROWNING_up/BROWNING_down 同一份文件），reverse=False。诱导棕色脂肪 = 脂肪燃烧 = 减肥，正分 = 化合物 mimics browning。
